name: Dr. Durga Prasad Mishra
role: Dean, School of Occupational & Physiotherapy, DRIEMS

bio: Distinguished healthcare professional and academician with over 11 years of clinical and teaching experience. Leading research in Neurodevelopmental Disorders (Autism, Cerebral Palsy) and regularly contributing to health columns, TV programs, and early intervention advocacy.

bio: Over 30 years of FMCG, personal care, and OTC healthcare industry leadership. Specializing in Sales, Marketing, brand launching with national footprints, and strategic planning. Utilizing analytical insight and corporate resilience to strengthen our nonprofit leadership.

name: Mrs. Barnali Sutar

bio: Expert special educator, teacher trainer, and therapist (Art, Play, and Brain Gym). Principal consultant for AIF evaluating secondary education. Advisory board member of NGOs like UDYAM and Odisha Blind Association, committed to creating conducive learning environments.

name: Mr. Jayanta Kumar Bhutia
bio: Over 3.5 decades of leadership in pharma Sales & Marketing, retired as a General Manager. Expert in team motivation, cross-functional coordination, compliance, administrative policy, and conflict resolution, guiding Emyris in administrative excellence.

bio: Renowned practicing lawyer handling Constitutional, Educational, Labour, Civil, and Criminal cases in the Odisha High Court, Labour Court, and other state tribunals. Actively guiding Emyris in legal advocacy, compliance, and community outreach.
